name: Nerest Client
changelog: BlockOverlay optimizacija: pilniba noversts FPS kritums (-50 FPS). Teksturas izskirtspeja samazinata no parmerigas 2048x2048 uz optimalu 512x512/256x256 (16x-64x mazak pikselu), 30 FPS shaderu throttlings un nonemts GPU pipeline stall readbacks

ShaderHands optimizacija: noversts item switch freezes. Resource pack skenesana parnesta uz asinhronu background thread (vairs nebloke render thread), nonemts premium_cache scans un ieviesta per-frame teksturas kesosana held item renderesana
